description: This file contains string utility functions for the ANGLE project, including string splitting, trimming, prefix/suffix checks, hex conversion, file reading, and string manipulation.

methods.name: SplitString
methods.description: Splits a string into a vector of substrings based on delimiters, with options for whitespace trimming and result type.

methods.name: SplitStringAlongWhitespace
methods.description: Splits input string into tokens based on whitespace characters.

methods.name: TrimString
methods.description: Trims specified characters from the beginning and end of a string.

methods.name: GetPrefix
methods.description: Extracts a prefix from a string starting at a given offset up to a delimiter.

methods.name: HexStringToUInt
methods.description: Converts a hex string to an unsigned int.

methods.name: ReadFileToString
methods.description: Reads entire contents of a file into a string.

methods.name: BeginsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string or C-string begins with a specified prefix.

methods.name: EndsWith
methods.description: Checks if a string ends with a specified suffix.

methods.name: ReplaceSubstring
methods.description: Replaces the first occurrence of a substring within a string with a replacement string.
